title: CoStrict stability control file v1 (vscode.json)
description: cs-cloud atomically writes ~/.costrict/telemetry/control/vscode.json; the plugin polls every 30s. FAIL-OPEN semantics (design §6): missing/empty/malformed/unknown-schema_major file means NO restriction (collect all purposes, policy_revision=0, account_epoch=unbound). Restriction only ever comes from a currently-valid explicit policy. Fields are identical to jetbrains.json.

enabled.description: Total authorization; false stops both purposes.

metrics_expires_at.description: UTC ms; effective deadline = min(own expires, common expires_at).

accepted_fact_schema_majors.description: consumer可重构的事实schema major；缺失等同[1]。v1插件仅解析不启用；包含2时高保真诊断(v2)才可能被放行
